description: This file defines the RequestInterface, an interface representing an outgoing, client-side HTTP request within the PSR-7 standard. It extends MessageInterface and includes methods for retrieving and modifying the request target, HTTP method, and URI. The interface stipulates immutability for implementing classes.

classes.name: RequestInterface
classes.description: An interface for HTTP client-side requests following PSR-7, extending MessageInterface. Defines methods for request target, method, and URI handling with an emphasis on immutability.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the request target of the message, such as origin-form, absolute-form, authority-form, or asterisk-form.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method used in the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method, ensuring immutability.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI associated with the request as a UriInterface instance.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header, and maintaining immutability.
